tasks.spec:
python3 -u - <<'PY' > bedrock.txt 2>&1
import json
import boto3
rt = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name="us-east-1")
ctl = boto3.client("bedrock", region_name="us-east-1")
try:
    profs = ctl.list_inference_profiles(maxResults=100)
    ids = [p.get("inferenceProfileId", "") for p in profs.get("inferenceProfileSummaries", [])]
    anth = sorted(i for i in ids if "anthropic" in i)
    print("PROFILES_ANTHROPIC=%d" % len(anth))
    for i in anth:
        print("  PROFILE %s" % i)
except Exception as e:
    print("LIST_PROFILES_ERROR %s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200]))
for mid in ("us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0", "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0"):
    try:
        r = rt.converse(modelId=mid, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": "Reply with the single word: ok"}]}], inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": 10})
        txt = r["output"]["message"]["content"][0]["text"].strip()[:40]
    except Exception as e:
        print("CONVERSE %s -> ERROR %s: %s" % (mid, type(e).__name__, str(e)[:250]))
    else:
        print("CONVERSE %s -> OK %r" % (mid, txt))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat bedrock.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q 'PROBE_DONE' bedrock.txt || { echo 'FAIL: probe did not finish'; head -5 bedrock.txt; exit 1; }; c=$(grep -cE '^CONVERSE .* -> (OK|ERROR)' bedrock.txt); [ "$c" -eq 2 ] || { echo "FAIL: expected 2 CONVERSE attempts, got $c"; exit 1; }; echo 'PASS: Bedrock access facts on record:'; grep -E '^CONVERSE|^PROFILES_ANTHROPIC|^LIST_PROFILES_ERROR' bedrock.txt | head -6
